Descript vs VEXI: Editor or Social Media in One App?
Descript and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Descript lets you edit video by editing the text, with an AI co-editor to help [1]. Here is how it compares with one app that also posts and plans your week.

Descript edits video and podcasts by editing the text of the transcript [1]. It removes filler words, adds captions, can generate B-roll and music, turns long recordings into clips, and drafts social posts [1][2]. Plans are priced per person: Hobbyist at $16 a month billed yearly ($24 monthly), Creator at $24 ($35 monthly) and Business at $50 ($65 monthly), with a no-cost plan of 60 media minutes a month [2].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is what happens after the edit. Descript is built around making the video: recording, editing, clipping, and sharing it as an export or a web link [1][2]. VEXI also schedules the post and puts it out on your connected accounts. VEXI costs more than Descript: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Descript edits video by editing the transcript, and its AI co-editor, Underlord, can turn a raw recording into a tight cut when you tell it what you want [1].
VEXI edits the video for you: cuts, B-roll, music and captions. How deep the edit goes depends on your plan's mode, and anything you ask for wins.
Descript reformats a video for YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and more, and shares it as an export or a web link [1][2].
VEXI schedules and posts to your connected accounts itself.

A superb editor for talking video and podcasts, with an AI co-editor that can do much of the cutting for you [1].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Can Descript make clips for social media?

Yes. Descript turns a long video or podcast into clips and reformats them for YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and more [1]. It can also draft social posts and video descriptions [2]. VEXI also schedules the post and puts it out on your connected accounts.

Descript's Hobbyist plan is $16 a person a month billed yearly or $24 monthly, Creator is $24 or $35, and Business is $50 or $65 [2]. Its no-cost plan includes 60 media minutes a month and 720p exports [2].
